notes.title: BATS: Bloodsucker Anti-Terror Squad Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
All of us at BATS HQ are very excited to announce the release of BATS: Bloodsucker Anti-Terror Squad, a love letter to the side-scrolling action games of the 16-bit era. BATS is based on the most violent animated show that never was! Vampires + terrorists = bloody good fun.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40713902/4c5cf2349dd7cbf617832f6b9989f876a97a6d80.gif[/img]

Pick it up for 10% discount at launch. Go BATS!
